From the outset, our mission has been to protect and secure our customers’ information systems, offering solutions tailored to their size, business sector and specific needs. Our Expertise in Cyber Defence Our expertise covers a wide range of services, including information systems architecture, infrastructure integration, network, server and storage management, and outsourcing for companies without an IT department. We draw on solid partnerships with major industry players to offer you cutting-edge solutions in firewall, antivirus, antispam/antimalware messaging and web filtering. Two Key Words: Attentive and Responsive Synexie stands out for its responsiveness and attentiveness to customers. We pride ourselves on offering personalized service and building long-term relationships based on trust. Our intergenerational team of passionate experts is committed to supporting and advising you throughout your digital security journey. A Certified Commitment We are committed to following French Cybersecurity Agency (ANSSI) guidelines and working with partners offering French and European solutions.
